author: Antigravity AI (Google DeepMind Team)
description: Complete A-to-Z architecture blueprint for multi-document local storage persistence, 800ms auto-save, responsive UI, export/import, and 1-page-per-day printing engine.

auto_save.flush_algorithm: If activeWeekId is 'current', check hasAnyData(state). If true, auto-generate a named week entry in archive and set activeWeekId to entry.id. If activeWeekId is a specific week ID, update that entry's data in the archive array.

multi_document.switching_logic: Call flush() if saving -> save new activeWeekId -> clearAllFieldsDomOnly() -> loadActiveWeek()

schema_migration.on_load: checkVersionAndMigrate() checks storedVersion vs APP_VERSION. If version changed, applies default fallbacks for missing cover titles/tags across live and archive entries and saves storedVersion.

fields.cover.title: Editable cover main title string
fields.{day}.mood: Array of 5 booleans representing selected mood emoji index
fields.{day}.water: Array of 8 booleans for water intake glasses
fields.{day}.hab{1..3}.d: Array of 7 booleans for habit pips (Mon-Sun)

toolbar.desktop_layout: Single sticky header row at top with primary actions, active badge, and inline tool buttons
toolbar.mobile_layout: 2-row responsive header (<750px): Row 1 has Title + Active Badge + '⚙️ More' toggle button. Row 2 has 3 primary action buttons ('📅 New Week', '📚 All Weeks', '✦ Add art').
toolbar.expandable_drawer: Clicking '⚙️ More' toggles #toolsDrawer containing Export JSON, CSV, Import, Print, Clear, and status metadata tags.

modals.archive_modal: Lists '📚 Your weeks' and '⚙️ Auto-saved' with Open, View, Rename, Delete actions.
modals.view_modal: Read-only tabbed modal displaying day-by-day contents with an '📂 Open & Edit this week' action button.

decorations_menu.toggle_menu: Floating dropdown (#artMenu) with checkboxes for individual decoration layers (sakura, sparkles, paws, clouds, hearts) and 'Enable all' toggle.

payload_structure.current: Object containing dumpAll() DOM key-value map
payload_structure.archive: Array of all saved week objects

json_import.validation: Parses JSON, verifies object structure, restores current & archive localStorage keys, restores activeWeekId, and calls location.reload().

csv_export.escaping: Quotes double-escaped if cell contains quotes, commas, or newlines

print_engine.page_break_rules: Page elements (.page, .daily-page) have page-break-after: always; break-after: page; page-break-inside: avoid; break-inside: avoid; height: 98vh; overflow: hidden;
print_engine.result: Exactly 1 A4 physical page per daily page (8 pages total per week planner).

implementation_checklist: 1. Add data-key attributes to all editable elements in your HTML skeleton.
2. Include localStorage persistence functions (loadActiveWeek, flush, queue, archiveWeek).
3. Bind input/change/click event listeners for auto-save (800ms debounce).
5. Include responsive CSS media query (<750px) for 2-row mobile layout & tools drawer toggle.
6. Include @media print CSS rules for 1-page-per-day printing.
7. Bind Export JSON, Export CSV, Import JSON, Print, and Clear buttons to the system handlers.
